title: Golden T-Shirt 3D preview meshing
description: Panel meshing for the arrangement preview of the Golden T-Shirt 3D fixture: flat panel meshes in panel-local millimetres whose boundary follows the pinned pattern contour.
notes: Frozen by maintainer decision on 2026-10-25 with the values unchanged from the provisional proposal. maxPlanarDeviationMm repeats the 0.10 mm of the tolerance profile d2p:golden-tshirt-3d 1.0.0; the sampling and triangulation values define a preview-quality mesh. This profile is immutable: a changed value is a new version.
